CDIS Integrity Covers

Choose the cover for the record.

Four cover types, manufactured by Peleman Industries. Spine sizes from 15 up to 340 sheets. The document, and the way it will be used, determine the choice.

The range

Four covers. One sealed standard.

01

Crystal Flex Covers

Proposals · reports · client deliverables

Clear front cover, so the first page of the document shows through. The title page does the presenting, and the seal does the protecting.

02

Hard Covers

Official records · court filings · archives

Rigid, book quality cover. For official records that are kept, handled and produced again over many years, and judged every time they are.

03

Soft Covers

Regular volume · working records

Flexible cover. For regular volume documents that still need to be properly finished, sealed and consistent with the house standard.

04

Full Colour Custom Covers

Branded · hard or soft

The organisation's own branding printed directly onto the cover, available in hard or soft. Every record leaves the building carrying your name, identically.

Sizing

How the sizes work.

The size number is the number of sheets. A size 40 cover holds up to 40 sheets of paper. A size 120 holds up to 120. The range runs from 15 up to 340. A sheet printed on both sides is still one sheet. Count the sheets in your document and take the size equal to or just above it. A 95 sheet agreement uses a size 100 cover.

Count sheets, including pages printed on both sides as one sheet.

Enter a sheet count to see a size recommendation.

This finder uses the sizes stated in this guide: 15, 40, 100, 120 and 340. The final size and availability are confirmed with your recommendation.
